meta.title: Neoplastic morphology experiments
meta.cell_line_note: 'Group 2's cell line' is a temporary placeholder pending colleague confirmation.
meta.study_note: Exploratory only: 4 slides, n=2 Vehicle and n=2 PLX4720 mice; mouse is the comparison unit.
meta.stats_note: Each mouse is one observation (2 vs 2). We report the raw PLX-minus-Vehicle difference, its size in interpretable units, an exact two-sided permutation p over the 6 ways to relabel the 4 mice (best attainable p=2/6≈0.333), and a leave-one-mouse-out check. The scaled difference is descriptive, not Cohen's d, and rests on only 4 mouse values.
meta.gate_note: The four gates are nested. Agreement across gates is a robustness-to-filtering check on one population, not independent replication.
meta.deferred: Foundation-model cell-crop embeddings are logged in TODO.md for a later pass.

featureClasses.shape: Nucleus outline shape. Robust to staining intensity; still limited by 20x resolution and segmentation quality.
featureClasses.size: Nuclear size. Robust to staining, but here mouse-specific rather than treatment-associated.
featureClasses.stain: Mean H&E optical density. Confounded by un-normalized slide staining; compare only within a slide.
featureClasses.texture: Within-nucleus chromatin texture. Per-nucleus normalized, but still scanner-focus/segmentation sensitive and not stain-matched.
featureClasses.spatial: Where the nucleus sits in the tumour. Used as a negative control, not a treatment readout.
featureClasses.quality: Model confidence; used only for gating.

gates.label: All non-edge neoplastic
gates.method: CellViT neoplastic nuclei, excluding edge-position nuclei and invalid geometry.

gates.label: High-confidence neoplastic
gates.method: Adds CellViT type probability >= 0.70 and broad geometry-quality limits to remove obvious segmentation artifacts.

gates.label: High-confidence neoplastic nuclei outside configured excluded roles
gates.method: Excludes the version-matched provisional semantic roles configured in cluster_roles.json gate_roles.exclude_from_non_necrotic: ['background_section_edge', 'pale_low_cellularity']. Reviewed cluster labels: ['background_section_edge_sparse_host_tissue', 'necrosis_enriched_injury_tissue_candidate'].

gates.label: High-confidence neoplastic nuclei in configured strict cellular roles
gates.method: Restricts to the version-matched provisional semantic roles configured in cluster_roles.json gate_roles.strict_cellular: ['cellular_tissue']. Reviewed cluster labels: ['viable_epithelioid_tumour_like_tissue', 'compact_tumour_interface_mixed_tissue'].

morphotypeDefs.label: Elongated neoplastic nuclei
morphotypeDefs.biological_read: Nuclei are more oval or spindle-like rather than round.
morphotypeDefs.method: Counted high-eccentricity neoplastic nuclei within each slide/gate.

morphotypeDefs.label: Round compact neoplastic nuclei
morphotypeDefs.biological_read: Nuclei are rounder and geometrically compact.
morphotypeDefs.method: Counted low-eccentricity, compact neoplastic nuclei within each slide/gate.
morphotypeDefs.criterion: eccentricity <= per-mouse-balanced broad-gate 25th percentile (0.583) and compactness >= median (0.730)

morphotypeDefs.label: Large neoplastic nuclei
morphotypeDefs.biological_read: Nuclei are in the larger end of the neoplastic population.
morphotypeDefs.method: Counted large-area neoplastic nuclei within each slide/gate.
morphotypeDefs.criterion: nuclear area >= per-mouse-balanced broad-gate 75th percentile (74.6 um2)

morphotypeDefs.label: Small compact neoplastic nuclei
morphotypeDefs.method: Counted small-area, compact neoplastic nuclei within each slide/gate.
morphotypeDefs.criterion: nuclear area <= per-mouse-balanced broad-gate 25th percentile (42.2 um2) and compactness >= median (0.730)

morphotypeDefs.label: Smoother haematoxylin texture
morphotypeDefs.biological_read: The haematoxylin signal inside the nucleus is less locally contrasted in the sampled cells.
morphotypeDefs.method: Counted sampled neoplastic nuclei with low haematoxylin texture contrast.
morphotypeDefs.criterion: H texture contrast <= per-mouse-balanced sampled broad-gate 25th percentile (1.685)
